**Is your feature request related to a problem?**
A clear description of the problem, e.g. "I'm always frustrated when […]".

**Describe the solution you'd like**
What you want to happen.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
Any alternative solutions or features you've considered, including other helpdesks.

**Who benefits?**
Tick all that apply:
- [ ] Self-hosters (setup / operations)
- [ ] Support agents (staff console)
- [ ] Super admins (admin panel / CRM)
- [ ] Customers (ticket flow / live chat)

**Additional context**
Mockups, links or any other context.
